p.n: Sailors Depend on Ships and Vice Versa

body.p: As people survive the sea with a ship, and the ship survives with the people;
therefore, I hope that we arrive, through cooperation, at survival for us both from this trouble.’

p.n: The Cat Puts His Trust in the Rat

body.p:
“When
the cat heard this from the rat, he knew that he was truthful and said, ‘You are correct and have spoken
the truth. See to the arrangement by which we can both be rid of this trouble, and I will act on it. I will remember
this favor forever and, I will ensure that I properly reward you for it.’

‘Allow me to approach to you,’ said the rat, ‘for if the owl and the mongoose see us in company,
they will leave us, and when I am in safety from them, I will cut your bonds while feeling secure.’

“The cat did so,
ensuring his safety, and the rat approached him.

“When the owl and the mongoose saw that, they left
the place,

p.n: The Rat Approaches to Cut the Rope

body.p:
and the rat took to cutting the net, one cord
at a time.

p.n: The Cat Deems the Rat's Efforts Slow

body.p:
“When the cat noticed that the rat was not diligent about cutting the net, he said,
‘What stops you, dear friend, is having secured your need for safety;

if that is
so, it is not a deed the righteous would do

p.n: The Rat Must Fulfill the Pact

body.p:
As I made haste to deliver you,
you should act likewise in delivering me.

And if you still remember that old enmity, you should not,
especially that I have done very well by you, and a deed of this kind, or a lesser one, should receive a gratitude that persists
